title: Mounting bracket
summary: An 80 × 50 mm angle bracket with a 6 mm wall, rounded vertical corners, and four 6.5 mm clearance holes. All dimensions are in millimeters.
script:
# Complete CadQuery construction.
part_0 = cq.Workplane('XY').box(*[80, 50, 6], centered=(True, True, False)).val()
part_1 = cq.Workplane('XY').box(*[80, 6, 44], centered=(True, True, False)).val()
part_2 = part_1.translate([0, 22, 6])
part_3 = part_0.fuse(part_2).clean()
part_4 = cq.Workplane('XY').newObject([part_3]).edges('|Z').fillet(1).val()
part_5 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3.25, 8])
part_6 = part_5.translate([-25, -6, -1])
part_7 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3.25, 10])
part_8 = part_7.rotate((0, 0, 0), [1, 0, 0], 90)
part_9 = part_8.translate([-25, 28, 30])
part_10 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3.25, 8])
part_11 = part_10.translate([25, -6, -1])
part_12 = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(*[3.25, 10])
part_13 = part_12.rotate((0, 0, 0), [1, 0, 0], 90)
part_14 = part_13.translate([25, 28, 30])
part_15 = part_4.cut(part_6, part_11, part_9, part_14).clean()
result = part_15
